steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as follows: Slot 1 – Opentrons 1000 µL filter tip rack; Slot 2 – Custom 12 mL tube rack containing samples in row A; Slot 5 – Custom 12 mL tube rack containing dilution buffer in wells A1, A3, A5, C1 and C3 (use as many wells as the number of samples, up to five); Slots 7‑11 – Visby devices (Visby 3 in slot 7, Visby 4 in slot 8, Visby 5 in slot 9, Visby 1 in slot 10, Visby 2 in slot 11).

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file from the source and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware files
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App Protocol tab, upload the downloaded .py protocol file.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the tip rack, sample rack, dilution‑buffer rack and the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 pipette using the OT‑App calibration routine (use calibration tips as described in the support articles).

steps.title: Transfer samples to dilution buffer
steps.instruction: Using the P1000 single‑channel GEN2 with 1000 µL filter tips, transfer up to five samples from row A in slot 2 to the dilution‑buffer wells in slot 5 in this order: A1, A3, A5, C1, C3.

steps.title: Add total sample volume to Visby
steps.instruction: After all samples are in the dilution‑buffer wells, aspirate the total combined volume of the transferred samples from slot 5 and dispense it into the appropriate Visby device(s).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT‑App to execute the protocol.
